name: Bronze Age Burial Site of Sammallahdenmäki
description: On a forested hill in Rauma, in western Finland, Sammallahdenmäki holds 33 granite burial cairns, piles of stone raised by Bronze Age people between roughly 1500 and 500 BC. Walking among these rocky mounds, some over 3,000 years old, you can see one of the largest and best-preserved sites of its kind in Fennoscandia. It was inscribed in 1999.
